test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"up."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Up" **is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it indicates movement towards a higher position or level.
 
• **Purple** symbolizes **"joint" **in the military world, meaning **"all services."**
 
• Grammatically,** "up"** is a preposition that can be used to indicate direction or location.
 
 
• **Example**: *Military students celebrate **Purple Up**__ Day during Month of the Military Child.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is **Option 1.**

Correct passage:

Dandelion is a widely distributed weed of the daisy family, __with__ a rosette of leaves and large bright yellow flowers followed __by__ globular heads of seeds with downy tufts. I also reminded them that April is designated as the Month of __the__ Military Child. Not many would know that 15 April is the day when we wear purple, or so to say, we ‘purple __**up**__’ to express our solidarity and support ______ (5) ______ the strength and sacrifices of our children, while their fathers are deployed at Siachen Glacier, deserts and on our borders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2, "by"**, is a preposition that can indicate means or method of doing something.

 
 
• **Example**: *She painted the picture by using watercolors.*
 
 
 
• **Option 3, "for"**, is a preposition that can indicate purpose or intention.
 
 
• **Example**: *We bought this gift for our friend's birthday.*
 
 
 
• **Option 4, "onto"**, is a preposition that can indicate movement to a surface or position.
 
 
• **Example**: *The bird landed onto the branch.*
